final:
WITH qc AS (
  SELECT q.constructorId, c.nationality
  FROM qualifying q
  INNER JOIN constructors c ON q.constructorId = c.constructorId
),
gc AS (
  SELECT constructorId, nationality, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM qc
  GROUP BY constructorId, nationality
),
nt AS (
  SELECT nationality, SUM(cnt) as tot
  FROM gc
  GROUP BY nationality
),
gwt AS (
  SELECT gc.constructorId, gc.nationality, gc.cnt, 
         CAST(gc.cnt AS REAL) / nt.tot as ratio
  FROM gc
  INNER JOIN nt ON gc.nationality = nt.nationality
),
ar AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_val FROM gwt
)
SELECT 
  gwt.constructorId,
  gwt.nationality,
  gwt.cnt,
  gwt.ratio,
  gwt.ratio / ar.avg_val as final_ratio
FROM gwt, ar
WHERE ar.avg_val IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY final_ratio IS NOT NULL DESC, final_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
